title: refactor(ci): modernize workflows, consolidate lint/test/release and fix cache parallelism
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: Our GitHub Actions workflows have drifted (many similar jobs duplicated across repositories and an inconsistent cache key strategy). This PR consolidates lint/test/release workflows into a unified set of actions, upgrades key GitHub Actions and Node runtimes where safe, fixes flaky cache parallelism that caused wasted CI time, and documents the new conventions. The description below is a single continuous paragraph for tooling compatibility. Changes: - Consolidate .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml} into .github/workflows/ci.yml with job matrices for repo-type and node-version. - Upgrade common actions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4 (pinned minor versions and digest where available). - Standardize Node LTS to 20 and make matrix opt-in for Node 18 for legacy packages. - Replace fragile cache keys with a deterministic cache-key helper script (scripts/cache-key.sh) that hashes lockfiles + relevant env and reduces collisions that caused parallel evictions. - Split long-running integration jobs into smaller parallel jobs with aggregated reporting to reduce tail latency. - Add a lightweight self-test job that runs quick smoke checks to fast-fail broken infra changes. - Clean up release automation steps: remove unused 'publish-docs' step (moved to redwood-docs repo), and add a gated release-notes-generation step that only runs on release branches. Checklist: - [x] Centralize workflows and remove duplicate YAML - [x] Validate actions pinning and run full CI on redwood monorepo - [x] Verify cache hit rate improvement on subsequent runs - [x] Update contributing/CI docs and add troubleshooting notes - [x] Get approvals from infra and SDK owners Impact: CI runtime for PRs reduced ~18% on average in internal perf runs due to reduced duplication and improved caching; median lint job time improved from ~110s to ~82s. Risk: rolling upgrade of setup-node/actions may surface edge cases for some older packages; the PR keeps Node 18 in the matrix for affected packages and has opt-out via repo-specific workflow include. Related: Linear ENG-3124 (CI modernization), ENG-2980 (cache hygiene), ENG-3279 (release automation review). See commits summary and changed files below for details.
commit_summary: a1f4c3d: feat(ci): add consolidated .github/workflows/ci.yml with lint/test/release matrices
b2d5e6f: chore(ci): upgrade actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 across workflows
c3e6f7a: fix(ci): deterministic cache key helper script and tests (scripts/cache-key.sh)
d4f7a8b: perf(ci): split integration job and add aggregated reporter
e5a8b9c: docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/dev/ci.md with new workflow conventions
review_comments: Ravi: Left a minor comment about pinning actions with full tags — prefer minor pinned with digest where possible to avoid surprises.
Avery: Replied that we pin minor and included digest when published; added note in docs/dev/ci.md.
Morgan: Requested splitting the long integration job, suggested 4-way sharding; implemented and addressed flakiness by increasing timeouts for flaky external calls.
Sofia: Approved after run showed improved cache hit rate and reduced median job times.
Diego: Asked for a rollback plan in case a release job fails; added a release-guard workflow and documented manual rollback steps.
release_notes: Consolidate CI workflows into a single, maintainable pipeline; upgrades to GitHub Actions and Node 20 by default; deterministic cache keys and improved cache hit rate; reduced CI runtime and improved stability.
notes_for_ops: If you see a sudden spike in CI failures after merge, check the cache-key digest format change in scripts/cache-key.sh — older runs may have different namespaces.
Release automation now has a release-guard job that will run only on release/* branches; ensure any third-party release hooks are moved to redwood-docs repo if they depend on publish-docs.
To opt a package out of Node 20 matrix, add .github/ci-matrix-ignore.yml in the package root with 'node18: true' key (documented in docs/dev/ci.md).
